description: Zones de sismicité - Normandie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by metadata.carmen.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. France has seismic zoning dividing the national territory into five zones of increasing seismicity according to the probability of occurrence of earthquakes:- a zone of seismicity 1 where there is no special seismic requirement for buildings at normal risk (the seismic hazard associated with this zone is classified as very low),- four zones of seismicity ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Seismicity zones - Normandy" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include seismes, sismicite. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
